items.title: 2.7.1 Working with Modules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of working with modules (PDF 55-56).

blocks.text: Python mein module bas ek file hai jis mein Python code ho, jaise functions, variables aur classes, jinhein program ke alag alag hisson mein dobara istemal kiya ja sake. Module banana aasan hai: code ek file mein likh kar .py extension ke saath save kar dein. Neeche module aur main function ke saath us ka istemal hai.
Step 1: greetings.py naam ki module file banayein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"# greetings.py": comment jo batata hai ke yeh code greetings.py naam ki file mein save karna hai; yahi file module ban jati hai.
"def say_salaam () :": say_salaam naam ka function banta hai.
"return "As - Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!"": function salaam wala text wapas (return) karta hai; khud print nahi karta.
Yeh file akele chalayi jaye to screen par kuch nahi aata, kyunke is mein function sirf banaya (define kiya) gaya hai, kahin bulaya (call) nahi gaya. Isay main.py (agla code) import kar ke istemal karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab function ka naam say_As-Salaam-Alaikum likhti hai. Python mein naam mein sirf letters, digits aur underscore aa sakte hain; hyphen (-) minus ka nishan hai, is liye SyntaxError aata hai. Yahan sahi naam say_salaam istemal hua hai, dono files mein.
Step 2: main.py naam ki doosri file banayein jo is module ko istemal kare. Is mein main function hoga jahan se program shuru hota hai:

# main.py
import greetings
def main () :
    message = greetings.say_salaam()
    print(message)
if __name__ == "__main__": main ()
# Output : As - Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"# main.py": yeh code main.py naam ki doosri file mein save hota hai, usi folder mein jahan greetings.py hai.
"import greetings": greetings.py module program mein laata hai (".py" nahi likhte).
"def main () :": main function banta hai jahan se program ka kaam shuru hota hai.
"message = greetings.say_salaam()": module ka function module ke naam aur dot ke saath bulaya jata hai; us ka wapas kiya text message mein aata hai.
"print(message)": text screen par aata hai.
"if __name__ == "__main__": main ()": main.py seedhi chalayi jaye to main() chalta hai; agar koi aur file isay import kare to yeh khud nahi chalta.
Output: As - Salaam-Alaikum, everyone! (hyphen ke aas paas spaces bilkul waise jaise string mein likhe hain).
Yeh code akele (greetings.py ke baghair) chalaya jaye to "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'greetings'" aata hai; is liye dono files ek hi folder mein honi chahiyein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab main.py mein bhi greetings.say_As- Salaam-Alaikum() bulati hai; yeh bhi ghalat naam hai. Sahi: greetings.say_salaam().

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Modules ke saath main function istemal karne se code organized (tarteeb mein) rehta hai aur sambhalna aasan hota hai. Program ka starting point (shuru hone ki jagah) hamesha main function se tay karein, aur code ke alag hisse alag modules mein rakhein.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Python ki standard library saikron (hundreds) modules se bani hai jo aam kaam karte hain, jaise dates ke saath kaam, random numbers banana ya files parhna.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
calculator.py naam ka module banayein jis mein do functions hon:
1. add(a, b): do numbers ka sum (jor) wapas kare.
2. subtract(a, b): do numbers ka difference (farq) wapas kare. Phir main.py likhein jo calculator import kare aur:
1. 15 aur 8 ka jor print kare.
2. 25 mein se 10 ghata kar print kare.
main.py chala kar dekhein ke output sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: calculator.py mein add(a, b) aur subtract(a, b) likhein aur main.py mein 15 + 8 aur 25 - 10 print karein.
blocks.explanation: calculator.py: def add(a, b): return a + b aur def subtract(a, b): return a - b. main.py: import calculator; print(calculator.add(15, 8)) se 23; print(calculator.subtract(25, 10)) se 15. python main.py se chalayein.

blocks.prompt: temperature_converter.py module banayein jis mein celsius_to_fahrenheit(c) aur fahrenheit_to_celsius(f) hon, aur main.py se 25 C aur 77 F badlein (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: temperature_converter.py mein: def celsius_to_fahrenheit(c): return 9 / 5 * c + 32 aur def fahrenheit_to_celsius(f): return 5 / 9 * (f - 32). main.py mein: import temperature_converter as tc; print(tc.celsius_to_fahrenheit(25)) se 77.0 aur print(tc.fahrenheit_to_celsius(77)) se 25.0.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Long question 7 mein kitab formulas F = | x C + 32 aur C = | x (F - 32) chhapti hai; '|' ki jagah fraction (kasar) honi chahiye. Sahi formulas: F = 9/5 x C + 32 aur C = 5/9 x (F - 32). Is se 25 °C = 77 °F aur 77 °F = 25 °C banta hai.

items: Function ke naam mein hyphen nahi chalta (say_salaam theek hai).
